name: Miyashiro (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Miyashiro town emblem in white: a stylised triangular device of rays with an interlaced knot.
history: Municipal flag of Miyashiro, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 May 1982.

features.role: Miyashiro town emblem — a stylised triangular device of rays with an interlaced knot
